methods: Rehashed captured source, source records, compiler AIR artifacts, summary/script/receipt bindings.
Read every captured file again from pinned local Git revisions with lazy fetching disabled; compared all declared primary before/after source bytes.
Verified quoted-header include-search closure for MLX and exact default C-string prelude/ordered runtime source reconstruction for DS4.
Checked compiler argv flags, successful exit codes and source/target artifact hashes.
limitations: Did not rerun compiler or execute upstream scripts/host code/GPU.
Compile success does not prove full-project link, actual runtime pipeline/function-constant variants, numerical correctness, performance or compatibility with every historical upstream build option.
DS4 warnings are retained, including macro redefinition/deprecated barrier declarations; they are not reported as warning-free builds.
These supplemental tests do not alter sealed dataset/admission identities; failed/incomplete earlier attempts remain historical evidence.
Records are trusted-local receipt consistency, not hostile-process attestation.
